purpose: engineering preparation only; not formal scientific results

uncertainty: Absolute paired BER half-width about 0.01994 over 32 hypotheses; cannot resolve 1e-3-scale differences or establish equivalence.
startupConclusion: Local engineering gates passed; current-head CI and separate exact-manifest human authorization required before formal start.
